name: craft
description: Autonomous senior-developer workflow for building features. Explores, interviews, designs via a dedicated architect, writes a directive-level plan, reviews it, gets approval, implements under fresh-context code review, polishes, and live-tests. Design gate fires when a boundary moves; plan gate always fires. Companion skills brainstorm a feature idea, design UI variants in Canvas, research a topic, prove a feature works locally, and monitor one in production.
